description:
We make premium wall art sets of three—available as framed prints or wrapped canvas—crafted to order with museum-quality materials. Creators like our high AOV (~$300), clear tiers, and simple rules that protect attribution.


Commission & tiers

• Base 15%

• 20% once you generate $1,000+ approved sales in a calendar month

• 25%+ for limited co-branded drops or high-impact partners (by individual agreement)

• Monthly tier review


Attribution & coupons

• 30-day cookie, last-click

• Coupon priority: your affiliate coupon overrides last-click for fair creator credit

• Each approved partner receives a unique 10% shopper code (format: affiliate_name10)


Samples

• Free samples up to $200 (site pricing) for vetted creators with strong audiences, after personal email approval

• Sample orders are not commissionable


Payouts

• PayPal in USD after the 30-day validation window

• Minimum payout: $50


Allowed promotion (enabled in this program)

• Blogs/Newspapers (editorial, reviews, roundups)

• Content creators & influencers (YouTube/IG/TikTok/Pinterest; #ad/#affiliate)

• SEO (original content; no brand impersonation/clone domains)

• Communities & Forums, Social groups & UGC (organic, value-add; no spam)

• Comparison shopping sites (accurate pricing, no auto-redirects, no scraped/fake prices, no browser extensions)

• Email marketing (opt-in lists; CAN-SPAM/GDPR/CCPA)

• Social messenger apps (organic recommendations)

• Direct linking to product/category pages (no checkout-deep links)


Not allowed

• Browser extensions/toolbars/coupon injectors; cashback/loyalty/incentivized traffic

• Paid media by affiliates (search ads, social ads, display, push networks)

• Pop-ups/unders/tab-unders, forced redirects, doorway/cloaked pages

• Adult/porn/gambling; any brand bidding or impersonation


Questions or collab ideas: partners@wallartset.com

term_and_condition:
1) Commission & tiers

  • Base commission: 15% of net merchandise value (after discounts; excl. shipping, taxes, gift cards).
  • Tier: 20% once you generate $1,000+ in approved sales in a calendar month.
  • Special cases: 25%+ for limited co-branded drops or high-impact partners (by individual agreement).
  • Tiers are reviewed monthly;

2) Attribution & cookies

  • Cookie window: 30 days, last-click attribution.
  • Coupon priority: Affiliate coupon codes override last-click to ensure fair credit for creators.
  • No cookie stuffing, forced clicks, hidden iframes, or similar tactics.

3) Coupons

  • Each approved partner receives a unique 10% code (format: affiliate_name10).
  • Only codes issued by WallArtSet.com are commission-eligible.
  • Public submission of our codes to coupon sites, code scraping, or listing fake/expired codes is prohibited and may lead to commission reversal or program removal.

4) Samples policy

  • We may provide free samples up to $200 (site pricing) for vetted creators with strong audiences, strictly after personal email discussion/approval.
  • Sample orders are not commissionable. We may choose specific products/variants for sampling.

5) Eligible orders & validation

  • Commissions validate after a 30-day window to account for returns/cancellations.
  • No commission on cancelled/refunded/fraudulent orders or orders placed with unauthorized discounts/codes.

6) Promotion channels — Allowed (as enabled in program)

  • Blogs / Newspapers — editorial, reviews, curated roundups (FTC/ASA disclosure required).
  • Content creators & Influencers — YouTube/IG/TikTok/Pinterest; disclose #ad/#affiliate; use your unique link/code.
  • SEO (Search Engine Optimization) — original content; no brand impersonation or clone domains.
  • Communities & Forums — organic, value-add posts and Q&A (no spam or mass link-drops).
  • Social groups & UGC — organic posts in groups/threads; no coupon spam.
  • Comparison shopping sites — allowed if you provide accurate pricing, clear product links, no auto-redirects, no scraped/fake prices, and no browser extensions.
  • Email marketing — opted-in lists only; comply with CAN-SPAM/GDPR/CCPA; visible sender; easy unsubscribe.
  • Social messenger apps — organic recommendations only; no bulk unsolicited DMs.
  • Direct linking / Direct traffic — linking to product/category pages is allowed; checkout-deep links are not.

7) Prohibited promotion & tactics

  • Browser extensions/toolbars/coupon injectors or any software that auto-applies codes or overwrites attribution.
  • Cashback, loyalty, incentivized traffic within this program.
  • Paid media by affiliates (search ads, social ads, display, push ad networks).
  • Pop-ups, pop-unders, tab-unders, forced redirects, doorway/cloaked pages.
  • Adult/pornographic, gambling, illegal, hateful, or misleading content.

8) Brand protection & paid-search rules

  • No brand bidding on “WallArtSet”, “Wall Art Set(s)”, misspellings, or close variants (add as negatives).
  • Do not impersonate our brand (domains, pages, ads, handles, support).
  • Use official assets we provide or your original content; do not misrepresent materials/quality.

9) Payouts

  • PayPal payouts in USD after the 30-day validation window.
  • Minimum payout: $50.
  • We reserve the right to hold or reverse commissions in cases of policy violation or suspicious activity.

10) Data, reporting & UTMs

Recommended UTM scheme:

utm_source=affiliate&utm_medium={channel}&utm_campaign=program&utm_content={handle}

We may request URLs/screenshots for verification and to resolve attribution disputes.

11) Changes & contact

  • We may update these terms at any time; continued participation implies acceptance.
  • Partnership ideas (seasonal drops, higher tiers, content plans): partners@wallartset.com
